invariants.expression: firstWidget == null || (firstWidgetBounds != null && firstWidget.getX() == firstWidgetBounds.x && firstWidget.getY() == firstWidgetBounds.y && firstWidget.getWidth() == firstWidgetBounds.width && firstWidget.getHeight() == firstWidgetBounds.height)
invariants.rationale: Ensures the first widget (if not null) has its bounds set to match firstWidgetBounds after layout().

invariants.expression: secondWidget == null || (secondWidgetBounds != null && secondWidget.getX() == secondWidgetBounds.x && secondWidget.getY() == secondWidgetBounds.y && secondWidget.getWidth() == secondWidgetBounds.width && secondWidget.getHeight() == secondWidgetBounds.height)
invariants.rationale: Ensures the second widget (if not null) has its bounds set to match secondWidgetBounds after layout().
If the split is not vertical, calculateHorizBoundsAndPositions() is called, which requires both widgets.
If firstWidget is null, its bounds likely should not be set, so firstWidgetBounds may be null.
If secondWidget is null, its bounds likely should not be set, so secondWidgetBounds may be null.
